_meta.method: ffmpeg silencedetect (-35dB/0.25s) + band-pass envelope syllable-nuclei peak-picking (15s windows) + scdet 0.30 sampled windows; cross-checked against video_analysis.md (whisper+acoustic, same video)
_meta.note_language: Vietnamese is monosyllabic: syllables/min ~= words/min. For English scripts multiply WPM targets by ~0.75 (EN averages ~1.3 syllables/word).

hook_0_30s.note: long holds between key words; envelope method reads ~208 due to SFX/meme audio in hook

climax.note: fastest at tech-optimism section ~540-570s (206 WPM whisper)

outro.note: drops sharply for the discussion question

targets_for_generated_video.comment: std/mean must be >= 0.10 across 15s windows; hook and outro each at least 25% slower than body mean; at least one climax window >= 10% faster than body mean

pauses.interpretation: breaths and natural gaps are edited OUT; almost all pauses are INTENTIONAL: ~4 long dramatic holds (>1.2s) at twist/chapter moments, rest are short 0.25-0.7s beats. Generated audio must NOT have uniform gaps: default inter-scene gap <= 0.25s, plus 2-5 deliberate 0.5-1.5s pauses at twists.

visual_pacing.burst_cutting: up to 6 cuts in 3s at high-energy lines (~96s mark)
visual_pacing.long_holds: 5-8s only on data tables/charts, always with slow ken-burns

audio_mix.voice: baritone, dynamic-range compressed, mean pitch ~220Hz, pitch std ~102Hz (very expressive; normal speech is 30-50Hz)
audio_mix.pitch_spikes: on quantity words and strong adjectives (measured up to ~450Hz)
audio_mix.bgm: ambient science/synthwave, -18 to -22dB under VO, tempo rises mid-video

qa_thresholds.comment: output_audit should FAIL (with suggestions) if any of these deviate >20% from target
